mission: Test whether binding/currentness representation changes finite-Agent recovery of an actionable institutional Now under adversarial authority and continuity pressure without moving owner truth into Computing.
questionOrHypothesis: Current physical/effective state is insufficient for institutional currentness in paired adversarial histories, and a deterministic owner-preserving CurrentBindingFrontier may reduce fresh-Agent standing/action errors relative to raw history alone.

internalStanding: Game C1: participant/material/runtime continuity do not determine GameInstance identity.
Security: credential possession != authority; continuity != control; authority change is prospective and history is not rewritten.
Normative: Permission != Power != Capability != EffectiveControl; ValidChange is predecessor/lineage-relative; genesis/replacement != amendment.
Interlocus: CurrentView != LatestRecord; Migration != Supersession; migration does not carry standing by default; conflict is preserved; Recovery != HistoryReset.
World: controller/process replacement != consequence replacement; UNKNOWN does not authorize a fresh consequence.

strongBaseline: Exact raw typed history with explicit event semantics and no intentionally misleading omission. The baseline is not a latest-value straw man in the model campaign; naïve latest/effective projection is used only as an S0 structural falsifier.
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: One deterministic reconstructable CurrentBindingFrontier over the same history; no new source fact, action recommendation, trust score, global authority lattice or persistent truth store.
independentOracle: Scenario answers are frozen from the deterministic event semantics before provider execution. Provider prose cannot change the oracle.
invalidityConditions: Any mandatory deterministic S0 gate fails.
The candidate projection contains an action recommendation or source fact absent from raw history.
Treatment and control use different underlying event histories, provider model, tool surface, evaluator or completion schema.
Provider/Harness failure is scored as semantic failure instead of apparatus-invalid.
A later claim is treated as current merely because it is later.
A full root compromise is labeled recovered without an independent standing-sufficient re-anchor in the frozen semantics.
authorityBoundary: Computing evaluates representation consumption only. World/Game occurrence, Security control/evidence, Normative validity/power and Interlocus currentness/binding semantics remain source-owner responsibilities.
stopRule: Do not proceed past S0 on semantic failure. Do not tune the same cases until a positive model result appears. A no-change or model-capacity-relative result is a valid closeout.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If the strongest raw-history baseline is equally reliable, retain only the cross-owner synthesis/negative result and do not engineer a CurrentBindingFrontier product surface.
rollbackRule: All apparatus lives in an isolated detached Computing workspace until reviewed; no owner repository is mutated by this experiment.
publicationBoundary: Results may establish only bounded representation/currentness effects and structural falsifiers. They do not establish academic novelty, a universal institution ontology, emergence, phase transition, or a new owner/service.
